For the opposite corners to have the same shown corner alignment, floor width and height must each be6 times a positive integer: the final apex is3 units from the other corner. Thus the finite rectangular floor is a union of complete6-by6 blocks and the global dark-area fraction is16/36=4/9, uniquely B. No infinite-area limit or crop-edge-as-floor-boundary assumption is used.
